summaries.en: The police officer responsible for the missing Jang Miran case in Jeju, who is suspected of falsely closing it, has been emergency arrested after it was revealed he also falsely closed another missing person case, while the search for Jang continues.
summaries.zh: 负责济州张美兰失踪案的警官因涉嫌虚假结案，且被发现还虚假结案了另一起失踪案而被紧急逮捕，目前对张女士的搜寻仍在进行中。
